flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 416 vs price 297 - margin of safety 28.5%

opportunities.point: Shanti Gold targets a top line value growth of 50% to 60% in the current year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Volume growth is expected to remain in the 30% to 40% range while value growth is expected in the 50% to 60% range compared to last year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Operations successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company has allocated around INR47 crores of capex for the Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.36 pp

opportunities.point: The company experienced continued momentum in its core business during Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The quarter also reflected continued momentum in our core business." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted strong demand across both export and local domestic markets following recent exhibitions.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "It's currently right now 75%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Designer jewellery accounts for 75% of revenue while plain gold jewellery represents 25%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The Jaipur facility is slated to become operational around mid-November or December.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

threats.point: Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.46 pp, DII -2.37 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Gold prices remained in a narrow range during the current year, with subdued demand in May and June.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Going ahead in this current year, actually, it has remained in a narrow band of say, around 142 to 150 range, right? And the May and June was quite subdued." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: High volatility in gold prices previously led the company to temporarily step back from Gold Metal Loans.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So earlier also we used to do GML and all, but due to the high volatility, we went on -- we came out from GML." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S23/W9/O29/T14), led by 'Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
